description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer_CSSDefinition, which is responsible for rendering CSS definitions into an HTML representation. It extends a base printer class and implements methods for rendering a CSS definition as an HTML table.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_CSSDefinition
classes.description: A printer class that generates an HTML representation of a CSS definition object.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates an HTML snippet displaying the CSS properties and definitions contained within the given configuration, rendered as a styled HTML table.
